name: Codebase Documenter
summary: Generates comprehensive documentation explaining how a codebase works, including architecture, key components, data flow, and development guidelines. Use when user wants to understand unfamiliar code, create onboarding docs, document architecture, or explain how the system works.

name: Flowchart Creator
summary: Create HTML flowcharts and process diagrams with decision trees, color-coded stages, arrows, and swimlanes. Use when users request flowcharts, process diagrams, workflow visualizations, or decision trees.
